verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a package manager, so a built-in background automation feature, such as scheduled auto-updates, is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence shows no first-party way to configure autonomous recurring automations. It only says brew can be called from admin scripts and scheduled jobs, which means the scheduling comes from the host platform or the user's own setup (adjacent support, not the capability itself).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use this in administrative scripts and scheduled jobs to manage an existing installation, including when no user is logged in.
